links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to connective tissue disease questions (Flesch Reading Ease Score)
links.effect: Average FRES 80.46 (7.19), rated 'easy' to read across the four LLMs; readability was not a barrier in this evaluation.
links.quote: The answers provided by the LLMs were "easy" to read, with an average FRES score of 80.46 (7.19).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance (accuracy, completeness, readability, detail, disclaimers) of multiple LLMs on 250 rheumatology questions scored retrospectively by clinicians without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
